decision.summary: Gas record is valid to 16 Oct 2026 but tenant unresponsive to three attempts. Opened JOB-101, wrote and texted tenant, asked HeatRight for slots, updated landlord, set review 12 Oct.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety?
answers.answer: Yes until 16 Oct 2026, per the compliance record (CP12 issued 2025-10-17, Gas Safe 550123, matching HeatRight). I trust it over the legacy note ('renewed 2025, all good'), which is vague hearsay and gives no dates. The CP12 PDF was not seen. After 16 Oct it is non-compliant without a new check.

answers.question: What steps to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Two earlier attempts unanswered; now a further email and SMS, a request to HeatRight for slots, and a follow-up on 12 Oct to phone, send a letter, then escalate. Written 24h notice of a confirmed slot; no entry without it and keys give no right of entry. Can renew up to 2 months early keeping the anniversary.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: Currently compliant until 16 Oct, tenant not responding, steps taken, we won't enter without notice, ask for any other contact route, next update 12 Oct.

conflicts: Legacy note says cert renewed 2025 'all good' vs compliance record expiry 2026-10-16; trusted the current compliance record.
